analysis.reason: 직전 판단(매수) 유지. RSI 중립 구간 회복, 5일 고가/저가 패턴은 횡보 구간이나, 5일 저가($75.47)가 20일 저가($66.55) 대비 13.6% 높아 Higher Low 패턴 초입 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 악화 중이나 아직 양수 구간 유지. 거래량은 위축 상태.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining previous buy action. RSI has recovered to the neutral zone, and while the 5-day price pattern shows consolidation, the 5-day low ($75.47) is 13.6% higher than the 20-day low ($66.55), indicating the start of a Higher Low pattern. MACD histogram is worsening but remains positive. Volume is subdued.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current phase diagnosis (early uptrend): entry conditions met, wait-and-see if RSI shows further upside confirmation
